title: Multilingual Brain Decoding Reveals Shared Cortical Semantic Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.26927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human languages differ markedly in lexical and syntactic form yet can convey similar semantic content. The neural basis of this cross-language semantic commonality remains unclear. Here we developed a multilingual brain decoding framework and analysed brain recordings from 227 participants spanning Chinese, English and French. We found that cortical semantic representations exhibited consistent semantic geometry relationships across languages and individuals, revealing a shared cortical semantic geometry. Importantly, the cross-language consistency of cortical semantic geometry increased from sensorimotor to higher-order association cortex, forming a shared semantic geometry gradient closely aligned with the principal cortical functional gradient. Our work establishes generalizable multilingual brain decoding and identifies stable cortical semantic geometry as a neural basis for semantic commonality across languages.

translated_title: 多语言脑解码揭示共享的皮层语义几何
translated_abstract: 人类语言在词汇和句法形式上差异显著，却能够传达相似的语义内容。这种跨语言语义共同性的神经基础至今尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们开发了一个多语言脑解码框架，并分析了涵盖中文、英文和法语共227名被试的脑记录数据。我们发现，皮层语义表征在不同语言和个体之间表现出一致的语义几何关系，揭示了一种共享的皮层语义几何。重要的是，皮层语义几何的跨语言一致性从感觉运动皮层向高阶联合皮层逐渐增强，形成一个与主要皮层功能梯度高度对齐的共享语义几何梯度。我们的工作建立了可泛化的多语言脑解码方法，并将稳定的皮层语义几何确定为跨语言语义共同性的神经基础。
tldr: 本研究开发了多语言脑解码框架，通过分析中、英、法语使用者共227人的脑记录数据，发现皮层语义表征在不同语言和个体间共享一致的语义几何，且这种跨语言一致性沿皮层功能梯度从感觉运动区向高阶联合区递增，从而为跨语言语义共同性提供了稳定的神经基础。
en_tdlr: This study develops a multilingual brain decoding framework and, by analyzing brain recordings from 227 Chinese, English, and French speakers, reveals that cortical semantic representations share a consistent semantic geometry across languages and individuals, with cross-language consistency increasing from sensorimotor to higher-order association cortex along the cortical functional gradient, providing a neural basis for cross-language semantic commonality.
